description: This file defines a hook in SuiteCRM, specifically an 'after_save' hook that invokes the 'run_bean_flows' method of the 'AOW_WorkFlow' class. It sets up a hook array if not already present and registers a callback to run after a save operation.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlow
classes.description: Class responsible for managing workflow logic in SuiteCRM, particularly executing flows after certain bean events.

methods.name: run_bean_flows
methods.description: Method invoked by the 'after_save' hook to execute workflow processes associated with a saved bean.
